Hi, I\'m Lior. I made this app for the community, with the intent to help. Nothing would make me happier than getting a genuine, thoughtful email about how someone used and appreciates this app.\n\nPlease describe with complete genuineness and honesty what about this app you liked, and if it made you feel a connection with me, its creator.
Also, putting apps in the Play Store costs me money. If you feel generous, you can buy me a beer (IRL or via the app).
